source_grounded_contract.population: Metadata and paper recruit 21 MEG participants. Paper main analysis excludes two participants with >80% identical choice actions; pinned source identifies IDs6 and19, leaving19. BIS additionally lacks subject1 and uses18.
source_grounded_contract.localizer: Three blocks; 7 image identities shown20 times each per block, 420 presentations total in paper. Pinned code selects phase LOC and block_number<4; imagery classes OUTCOME1,OUTCOME2,OUTCOME3,CHOICE1..4 map to1..7.
source_grounded_contract.epochs: Pinned epoch code uses localizer -250:10:600ms and task0:10:500ms; arrays trial x sensor x time, three localizer run cells/eight task cells concatenated in run order. Safe channel alignment and row identity require actual native validation.
source_grounded_contract.classifier: Binary outcome classifiers1..3 trained against all7 classes and equal-count null data drawn at-200ms. L1 lambda .002, L2 0, no temporal embedding. Binomial lassoglm Standardize false, alpha1. Task logits include intercept; sigmoid produces activation probabilities.
source_grounded_contract.scaling: Paper explicitly says divide data by its95th absolute percentile. Pinned code invokes absent scaleFunc separately on augmented localizer matrix and flattened task matrix. Axis, interpolation, and exact function are unresolved. A train-only scalar flattened95th absolute percentile is defensible explicitly prospective choice; zscore would depart from known paper transform.
source_grounded_contract.first_level: Pinned code: y=RP(O2)-RP(O1); X=[1,(5-choice_number)/5-.5,abs(o2_val)-abs(o1_val)]. Per test time, keep RT>=test_ms, then pinv(X)@y. Safe signal is mean RP(OS) over same eligible rows. Missing/rank-deficient rows should remain visible as unsupported.
source_grounded_contract.paper_equation_difference: Paper Eq7 uses O1-O2 and p1-p2. Reversing both signed outcome and reward differences preserves reward beta; code probability regressor is half the reversed probability difference, hence code beta_prob=2*paper_eq7_beta_prob.
source_grounded_contract.published_second_level: Source uses MATLAB robustfit defaults on zscored subject neural/behavior vectors per time cell; Gaussian sigma1.5 bins with zero padding;5000 participant permutations and extremum statistic. Paper main domain train20..500,test0..500. Script observed extrema cover full0..500 maps while permutation crops first2 train rows, a mismatch to resolve before numeric reproduction.
source_grounded_contract.behavioral_fields: descriptive.jl selects phase TEST, block_number>7, accept!=NA. Fields include s_num,choice_number,rt,o1_val,o2_val,safe_val. choice_number1..4 initially yields p_o1=[.2,.4,.6,.8]; p_o2=1-p_o1. Native fit optionally updates probabilities on accepted outcomes. Objective fixed-probability EV difficulty abs(p_o1*o1+p_o2*o2-safe_val) is a prospective control, not subjective difficulty ground truth.
source_grounded_contract.behavior_fit: Paper uses hierarchical EM and integrated BIC. Pinned launcher references missing likfuns2.jl, undefined learn_prob_list/sub_baseline_list/use_additive2_list, private paths; actual likfuns_AH_Pros.jl exists. This prevents claiming native standalone replay merely from entrypoint presence.
source_grounded_contract.rights: Data declared CC0 by canonical contract; source tree provides no LICENSE. Do not vendor author code or assert rights resolved. Open access article content does not settle stimulus/component rights.
